'''Personnel Routing''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] office located in [[Market City]] on the [[Swamp|swamp]] planet [[Lotide]] in the [[Mortex sector/Legends|Mortex sector]]<ref name="TEA-OC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]].<ref name="BI" /> [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Benkin]] of the nearby [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Technical Branch Outpost (Lotide)|Technical Branch Outpost]] threatened to report a team of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] spies to Personnel Routing when they showed up unexpectedly posing as recent scientist transfers from [[Dakot Seven]].{{Fact}}
